result.reason: The clause otherwise follows the fallback: it is mutual, limited to direct solicitation of employees involved in the services, includes both required carve-outs, and removes the no-hire restriction. However, “during the term ... and” may continue the restriction for the entire Agreement term even when an individual’s involvement ended more than 12 months earlier. The restriction should instead apply during the individual’s involvement and for 12 months thereafter. The margin comment does not cure this operative-language issue.
